preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 400000 and isinstance(k, int) and 1 <= k <= 200000 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (vertices) and k (operations) are integers within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges) for n, k, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case provides exactly n-1 edges with valid vertex indices and no self-loops.

preconditions.expression: all(sum(n for n, k, edges in test_cases) <= 400000)
preconditions.description: The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 4*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and 0 <= int(line) <= n for line, (n, k, edges) in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer representing the count of remaining vertices, bounded by 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(count_remaining_vertices(n, k, edges) == int(line) for line, (n, k, edges) in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the number of vertices remaining after k operations of removing all current leaves.
